description: Machine-readable source for Green Goods vocabulary enforcement. The linter reads linter_enforced and renamed_terms. Prompt-only lists guide design agents and are projected into the public glossary.

linter_enforced.scope: user-facing strings in i18n JSON message values
linter_enforced.rationale: These terms signal growth-hacking or FOMO patterns that conflict with the regenerative design review lens. See DESIGN.md and .claude/skills/design/review-checklist.md.

renamed_terms.scope: user-facing strings and keys in i18n JSON message catalogs
renamed_terms.rationale: The garden role is a Steward. Deployed GardenRole and isOperator wire names remain code identifiers; visible role copy uses Steward. The exempt keys refer to literal solar field technicians.
renamed_terms.locale_terms_rationale: Locked visible terms: es Responsable, pt Responsável. ICU argument names are code and are skipped.

prompt_vocabulary_admin_banned.scope: AI-prompt vocabulary for admin-cockpit screens; guidance only
prompt_vocabulary_admin_banned.rationale: Admin is a restrained steward cockpit. Hero moments belong to the client PWA. Glass is restricted to Navigation and FAB chrome; dense surfaces remain solid.

prompt_vocabulary_client_banned.scope: AI-prompt vocabulary for client PWA screens; guidance only
prompt_vocabulary_client_banned.rationale: The client PWA is a garden journal, not a steward cockpit. It uses warm narrative copy and Inter; cockpit and KPI language belongs to admin.

consumers.reads: all sections for the generated glossary
